item.title: Overgrown Tree Maintenance at unoccupied Council Tenancy, 7th August
item.description:
I am a resident of the property which directly adjoins the council property listed on Rangefield Road. I wish to raise an issue regarding a large tree located in the rear garden of this tenancy. This bromley council property is currently unoccupied. The tree has grown completely out of proportion for a residential garden. It heavily overhangs my boundary, entirely blocking light and depositing excessive heavy debris. I am concerned about the overall safety and upkeep of the tree, as it appears unmaintained. Action Requested: Could this issue please be passed to the relevant Housing Tenancy Officer or District Manager? I request that the council attends and arranges for the council’s tree care team to assess whether boundary pruning can be carried out. Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your response.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Rangefield Road, Sundridge, Greater London
